payload.state: Mediation efforts to end Ukraine crisis step up as Solana due in Kiev (AFP) AFP - Attempts to mediate the political crisis in Ukraine are gathering pace with EU foreign policy chief Javier Solana and Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski expected in Kiev.

criteria.business: Business news: stock markets, earnings, economy, oil and commodities, trade, mergers, airlines, retail and companies outside the technology sector.
criteria.sci_tech: Science and technology news: technology companies and their products, earnings or lawsuits (e.g. Microsoft, Google, Apple, IBM, Intel), software, hardware, internet, telecom, video games, space, and scientific or medical research.
criteria.sports: Sports news: games, matches, athletes, teams, leagues, scores, transfers and results.
criteria.world: World news: international affairs, politics, governments, elections, wars, conflicts, disasters and crime. Not business, sports or technology.
